recommendation: Keep the source fix. It directly completes the published BRR decision for the active current-build artifacts and keeps checked-in examples/search-parameter source consistent with the new required status fields. Handle FHIR-31780 and FHIR-31830 only as separate issue audit records.
issue_request: FHIR-31790 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested that status never be CodeableConcept, but instead be a 1..1 code, isModifier=true, using the draft/active/retired/unknown value set already used by other knowledge resources; the resolution also explicitly said to do the same for ClinicalUseDefinition.
initial_application: No direct FHIR-31790 source application commit was found. Earlier FHIR-26658 history added PackagedProductDefinition.status as an optional CodeableConcept, and FHIR-31780 applied the required code/PublicationStatus pattern to AdministrableProductDefinition, ManufacturedItemDefinition, and Ingredient, but MedicinalProductDefinition.status, PackagedProductDefinition.status, and ClinicalUseDefinition.status still remained optional CodeableConcept elements with preferred PublicationStatus bindings.
additional_context: In the current build, the R4 MedicinalProduct and MedicinalProductPackaged artifacts correspond to MedicinalProductDefinition and PackagedProductDefinition. source/fhir.ini lists MedicinalProductDefinition, PackagedProductDefinition, and ClinicalUseDefinition as active BRR resources with normative/approved status. BRR Confluence pages record the FHIR-31790 vote and related status/canonical-resource discussion with FHIR-31780 and FHIR-31830; FHIR-31830 is already represented on the combined branch for SubstanceDefinition.
reconciliation: The commit updates the three StructureDefinition status elements to min 1, max 1, type code, required ValueSet/publication-status bindings, common-binding metadata, and retained modifier semantics. It also updates status search parameter descriptions, removes obsolete ClinicalUseDefinition status type/cardinality/binding mapping divergences, and adds active status values to checked-in examples and invariant tests containing these resources.
source_changes: Updated source/medicinalproductdefinition/structuredefinition-MedicinalProductDefinition.xml, source/packagedproductdefinition/structuredefinition-PackagedProductDefinition.xml, and source/clinicalusedefinition/structuredefinition-ClinicalUseDefinition.xml so the affected status elements are required code values bound to ValueSet/publication-status.

Updated the corresponding status search parameter descriptions in bundle-MedicinalProductDefinition-search-params.xml, bundle-PackagedProductDefinition-search-params.xml, and bundle-ClinicalUseDefinition-search-params.xml.

Removed obsolete ClinicalUseDefinition status type/cardinality/binding divergences from clinicalusedefinition-definition-mapping-exceptions.xml while leaving remaining comment/requirements exceptions intact.

Added active status values to checked-in MedicinalProductDefinition, PackagedProductDefinition, and ClinicalUseDefinition examples and invariant-test fixtures that would otherwise violate the new 1..1 status cardinality.
